business.description: Nila Infrastructures Limited is a civic urban infrastructure company with over three decades of experience, specializing in slum rehabilitation, housing redevelopment, affordable housing, and public infrastructure such as bus terminals, BRTS corridors, healthcare facilities, multi-level parking, and industrial parks. The company operates on PPP, EPC, and turnkey models for government and private clients.

outlook.statement: Ahmedabad and other urban regions continue to offer significant potential for infrastructure-led growth. With increasing urbanization and evolving civic needs, the demand for well-planned, scalable solutions is greater than ever. Leveraging our experience, execution capabilities, and strong institutional relationships, we are well-positioned to capture these opportunities while remaining aligned with national priorities in housing and urban development.
Company envisages sustainable business growth on back of enhanced pre-qualifications/bidding capacities and meaningful Affordable Housing development orders providing multi-year visibility.

Gujarat remains a key growth driver with strong economic fundamentals, expanding industrial activity, and increasing demand for modern infrastructure; state attracted FDI inflows of US$5-6.5 billion in FY26.
Affordable housing sector expected to maintain strong long-term growth momentum supported by favourable demographic trends, continued urban expansion, and sustained government focus.
Industrial parks and logistics sector expected to remain a key growth driver supported by policy reforms, infrastructure expansion, technological advancement, and supply chain integration.
Large-sized urban infrastructure projects in Gujarat expected to materialize based on 28,360 MoUs executed during latest Vibrant Gujarat summit.
Company is confident to benefit from Bus Port projects in Gujarat (Amreli and Modasa) and Medical/Health construction opportunities post COVID-19.

Strong demand and investment foreseen in short to medium term for logistics/warehousing sector; industry expected to witness structural shift over next 3-5 years with consolidation and value-added services.

MOU with Kataria Group for industrial/logistics parks near Bechraji automobile hub (90 km from Ahmedabad) offers strategic advantage; company has already delivered 5 dormitories, commercial complex, and sizeable logistic warehouses.

SEBI notification on SM REITs (minimum ₹50 Crore, 200 investors) creates opportunities; company possesses premium land bank near Bechraji capable of developing industrial parks/warehouses for such funds.
Your Company is getting ready to bid for new orders and has identified favourable orders in pipeline to be executed across segments and geographies.
The management expects normalization of operating cash flows as project milestones are achieved and collections are realized in subsequent periods.

Unique business model: Diversified across EPC/LSTK, EPC+PPP, PPP modes for Affordable Housing and Urban Infrastructure; leasing ensures steady cash flow, government contracts assure timely recovery, PPP projects ensure better profitability margins
In-house expertise in entire gamut of construction and execution including design, planning & estimation, project preparation, execution, interior designing, integration of project management
Integrated Project Management Control System (web-based collaborative ERP platform) for planning, scheduling, monitoring, control across projects, contracts, finance and execution
Project evaluation framework covers Principal, Pre-development, Finance, Construction, Market parameters with risk mitigation in three parts
Joint ventures formed to share risk, cost, experience and expertise; construction work invariably carried out by Nila Infrastructures

Gujarat Affordable Housing Policy 2014 (Mukhya Mantri GRUH Yojana) with three models: Public Agency on Public Land, Private Developer on Public Land through PPP, Private Developer on Private Land, plus Slum Rehabilitation in PPP

Slum rehabilitation: ~7,00,000 families in Gujarat urban slums; eligible dwellers get minimum 25 sq. mtr. carpet area houses with basic amenities free of cost; ownership rights after 15 years; developer incentives include additional FSI, TDRs, free-hold rights on balance land, exemption on developmental charges
Housing redevelopment: Facilitates temporary relocation of residents, dismantles existing structures, builds new units per modern standards; monetizes additional saleable units and TDRs
